comment_letters.staff_ask: Because Keytruda was 46% of 2024 revenue, staff asked Merck to file the Keytruda license agreements as exhibits or explain why it is not substantially dependent on them.
comment_letters.company_answer: Merck said it owns all rights to pembrolizumab, so it is not dependent on the two royalty-bearing licenses (6.5% falling to 2.5% in 2024 and ending 12/31/2026; plus 2% expiring by country), and filed nothing.
comment_letters.next_filing_disclosure: FY2025 10-K repeats the same royalty language (6.5% to 2.5%, through 2026, also applies to Keytruda Qlex; 2% royalty expired US Sep 2024 and major EU 2H25 but continues elsewhere); no agreement filed.
comment_letters.next_filing_cite: data/corpus/companies/MRK/10k_FY2025.md pdf 56 / printed 54; prior year data/corpus/companies/MRK/10k_FY2024.md pdf 55 / printed 53
